summary: Iter150-B RETEST of the 2 issues flagged in iteration_76.json. RESULT: BOTH FIXES VERIFIED PASS. (1) Homepage account-type cards: section.bg-gray-50/80 + 3 cards (bg-blue-50/80, bg-purple-50/80, bg-emerald-50/80) now compute backgroundColor = rgba(30,41,59,0.6) → luminance 39.8 (was 245-250). All 4 cards are dark. (2) /pricing comparison table: 16 td cells with bg-purple-50/30 all compute bg lum=39.8 with text-gray-700 darkened to rgb(203,213,225) lum=211.4 → Δ contrast=171.6 (was 35). Also covers text-emerald-600 cells with Δ=149.6. Pricing total light leaks: 0. Modal verification PASS: /app/residents '+ إضافة مقيم + عائلة' modal opens with teal header 'إضافة ساكن رئيسي جديد', dark body, dark inputs, light labels, readable action buttons (screenshot 06). Light-mode regression PASS: localStorage.removeItem('darkMode') + reload → html.dark removed, body bg = rgb(255,255,255) on both / and /pricing. Backend smoke PASS: /api/health 200, /api/auth/login testcompany2 200. The CSS attribute-selector approach in /app/frontend/src/index.css (lines 280-358 using [class*='bg-X-50/'] for /opacity variants) is working as designed.

issues: 32 TR rows use bg-white/[0.02] (decorative striping) — the raw luminance metric reports lum=255 but actual alpha=0.02 makes them essentially invisible on the dark gradient. Not a real leak; the audit script's lum-only check is too strict for ultra-low-alpha whites. No action needed.

critical_code_review_comments: The [class*='bg-X-50/'] attribute-selector pattern in /app/frontend/src/index.css (lines 280-358) is a clean, future-proof fix — it catches every Tailwind /opacity-modifier variant (e.g., bg-purple-50/30, bg-blue-50/80) without needing to enumerate exact opacity values. The trailing '/' correctly prevents matching the -500 shade. Recommend keeping this pattern for any future tailwind color shade additions.

Iter76 unresolved sidebar UX issue still stands (NOT a dark-mode bug, just surfaced during prior testing): /app/audit, /app/security, /app/family-members return 'الصفحة غير موجودة' for company_admin role. Not in scope of this retest.
